title: EnableZKey - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to z-key on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableZKey(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables z-key. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable z-key myLayer.EnableZKey()
; Disable z-key InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableZKey(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsZKeyEnabled - InputEnableLayer
